scope: Actual FerroUI Gallery renderer smoke evidence for all light pages, nine representative dark pages, and eight named NavigationView examples in both themes. This manifest preserves separate historical capture evidence and does not assert upstream pixel parity or complete port acceptance.

source_commits.binding: Commit and tree supplied by the publishing owner. The current capture.rs and executed binary digests were independently verified against the execution record. The capture commit identifies the matching source; it is not an embedded binary build identifier.

measurement.png_sha256: SHA-256 of the original PNG file bytes.
measurement.raw_rgba_sha256: SHA-256 of Pillow Image.open(path).convert("RGBA").tobytes(), in row-major RGBA order with 8 bits per channel; no resizing, cropping, or color correction.
measurement.opaque: Every decoded RGBA alpha value equals 255. RGB PNGs receive alpha 255 during the documented conversion.
measurement.nonblank: At least one decoded RGB channel has unequal minimum and maximum pixel values. This checks image variation only, not correctness of rendered content.
measurement.distinct: Counts of distinct whole-file PNG SHA-256 and decoded raw-RGBA SHA-256 within each stated scope.
measurement.retained_copy: shutil.copyfile followed by full source/destination byte equality and PNG SHA-256 verification. No image pixels were edited.

cross_scope_duplicate_groups.note: The default light NavigationView page viewport equals the named data-binding viewport in this execution. They are counted as two output files and one distinct image.

visual_review.method: Direct inspection of exact PNG files with view_image; the API example was reopened at original resolution in both themes.

findings.observation: The default Auto pane is closed compact at the sample width. Four icon rows, the first-item selection marker, bottom Settings icon, Sample Page 1 heading, and blue/gray content tiles are visible. Missing symbol glyphs limit recognition of icon-only rows on this host.

The Top pane shows four readable menu captions, the first-item selection underline, right-side Settings, and This is Header Text. The native back-button row occupies additional vertical space; the inner sample content scroll viewer clips the lower paragraph within its viewport.

The adaptive example uses Top orientation at the capture window width. Four menu captions and Settings are visible, with the first item selected. The absent navigation header follows this example configuration; sample body text is partially visible within its viewport.

The tabs example shows four horizontal menu captions, the first-item selection underline, and right-side Settings. Its collapsed back button leaves more height for the sample body. This static frame does not exercise SelectionFollowsFocus.

The data-bound example renders compact item icons, the first selection marker, separator spacing, bottom Settings, and Sample Page 1 content. Category captions and the group heading are hidden in the compact presentation.

The open left pane shows selected Browse, Track Order, and Order History, with Account, Your Cart, and Help in the footer. Settings is intentionally disabled for this example. The Left mode radio option is selected. The narrow content region retains the sample blue tile minimum width, leaving a narrow gray tile.

The open left hierarchy shows selected Home, collapsed Account and Document options with chevrons, bottom Settings, and the Left mode radio option. The sample heading and tiles are present. Expanded descendants and popup states are outside this initial-state capture.

The API example shows the open left pane title, header, AutoSuggestBox, Menu Item1, Actions heading, Menu Item2, Menu Item3, and Settings at the bottom left near y=879. Option labels and initial checked states are readable. The initial Frame is blank because this example has no initial selected item.
findings.review_correction: An earlier observation incorrectly reported that Settings was absent. Reopening these exact full-resolution light and dark files confirmed that Settings is present; there is no outstanding missing-Settings rendering defect.

limits: Decoded-image measurements cover all 151 files. The primary observations list nine directly inspected frames; the separately recorded light-theme and InfoBadge reviews bring the combined reviewed scope to 18 unique frames. No visual review is claimed for the other 133 outputs.
Missing Segoe symbol glyphs on the Linux host produce square fallback marks for some menu, search, back, toggle, and Settings icons. This especially limits icon-only compact-pane readability.
Native default templates are functional adaptations; these captures are not Windows WinUI screenshots and do not establish exact source styling or pixel parity.

Named-target BringIntoView captures the existing Gallery viewport. Adjacent example fragments can remain above or below the target; the image is not a cropped control screenshot or a full-page screenshot.
NavigationSample1 contains its own ScrollViewer and a blue tile with MinWidth=250. Partial paragraph visibility and a narrow gray tile in small content regions follow those sample layout constraints.
These are initial-state frames. Expanded hierarchy popups, input sequences, focus movement, accessibility host behavior, transitions, and all option combinations require separate evidence.
